paragraphs: Shimon ben Antipatras, who fed guests and afterward flogged them. Rabban Yohanan ben Zakkai sent R' Yehoshua to him, and he did not flog him. He explained that it was because they made vows and transgressed them: Derekh Eretz, chapter 6.
